purpose: choose definitive individuals per cell mechanically from the frozen GLMM operating-characteristic robustness surface

rule.selection: smallest individuals_per_cell whose worst scenario meets every frozen threshold
rule.counterbalance: every evaluated N must be a multiple of four
forbidden: averaging a failing robustness scenario away
selecting a larger or smaller N after viewing confirmatory outcomes
changing H1/H2 thresholds after viewing the final power surface
selecting N from the best-case scenario
using a power surface with only one scenario at a candidate N
mixing different H1/H2 SESOI values across robustness scenarios
mixing SESOI provenance across robustness scenarios
mixing different trials-per-individual designs in one final-N selection surface
rule.robustness_boundary: nuisance/baseline/colony-allocation assumptions may vary across scenarios, but the scientific SESOI target, provenance and trials-per-individual design are frozen across the entire surface

machine_surface.output: JSON receipt containing selected N, total randomized N, all candidate worst-case metrics, frozen rule, and SHA-256 of power surface and rule

preregistration_link: the preregistration finalizer must verify that individuals_per_cell equals the selected N in the hash-matching final-N receipt
current_status: no real final-N receipt exists because procedural pilot and final robustness power surface are not yet available
claim_ceiling: The selector removes analyst discretion from choosing N once the robustness surface and thresholds are frozen. It does not determine the scientific SESOI or threshold values themselves.
